## NiceWurst!

![Nice](https://i.imgur.com/zrJcDNf.png)

NiceWurst — curated, survival-focused variant of the [Wurst7-CevAPI](https://github.com/cev-api/Wurst7-CevAPI) client, itself based on [Wurst](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7).

![ClickGUI](https://i.imgur.com/DhhqLX9.png)

## What Makes NiceWurst Different?

Config files are stored under `.minecraft/nicewurst/`, separately from regular Wurst7-CevAPI settings.

NiceWurst uses an explicit allowlist in `NiceWurstModule.java`; features outside that list are disabled and hidden when the NiceWurst build is active.

NiceWurst hides the Alt Manager, Anti-Fingerprint controls, and XRay block manager. Supported ESP and tracer rendering also respects depth testing and line of sight and do not give any PvP benefit or advantage over another player.

NiceWurst is not advertised as a cheat or hacked client and does not include aim assist, flight, speed hacks, or automatic/assisted PvP. It is curated around survival-friendly quality-of-life, building, rendering, and utility features. Users are still responsible for following server rules.

NiceWurst is compliant with the [Modrinth Content Rules](https://modrinth.com/legal/rules).

## Features

### Blocks

* AutoBuild - Builds selected templates after a starter block is placed, with named templates and `.autobuild` command support.
* AutoSign - Automatically writes configured text to signs as they are placed or edited.
* AutoTool - Selects the fastest applicable tool and can use tools from the inventory when appropriate.
* AutoClicker - Performs configurable repeated clicks for selected block or interaction workflows.
* SpeedNuker - Breaks nearby blocks rapidly, with mining modes, tool switching, left-click activation, and tool-preservation controls.
* Nuker - Breaks nearby blocks according to configurable range, filters, and mining modes.
* BuildRandom - Places selected blocks with randomized placement for varied builds.
* BedBreakAura - Finds and breaks beds around the player.
* Excavator - Breaks blocks throughout a selected area while moving through it.
* HandNoClip - Interacts with blocks through obstructions and supports targeting boats through walls.
* InstantBunker - Builds a small defensive bunker around the player.
* MusicAura - Interacts with nearby note blocks and music-related blocks automatically.
* ScaffoldWalk - Places blocks beneath the player for safer bridging and walking.
* SilkOnly - Prevents configured blocks from being broken without Silk Touch.
* TargetPlace - Places blocks at the selected target with improved placement handling.
* TemplateTool - Creates and applies AutoBuild templates by scanning structures.
* SourceFill - Finds nearby water and lava sources, highlights them, and fills them with configured blocks.
* SuperInstaMine - Uses packet-based mining to break blocks quickly, with pattern, tool, direction, and rendering controls.
* FastFill - Fills every reachable position in a selected area with a chosen block, with range, speed, replace, air-place, and tool-switch controls.
* AutoSpawnProofer - Finds nearby spawnable blocks and can place configured light sources, with range, light-level, and ESP settings.
* AreaNuker - Breaks reachable blocks inside a selected box while moving through it.

### Chat

* AutoChat - Provides configurable AI-assisted chat completion with editable prompts and model settings.
* ClientChatOverlay - Separates client messages from chat and supports routed messages, clickable components, wrapping, chat heads, and server username colors.
* Mention - Plays a selected sound when the player’s name is mentioned.
* NoPlayerChat - Filters or silences player chat.
* ChatSpam - Repeats a configured message or sends messages line by line from a file.
* CommandSpam - Repeats a configured command or sends commands line by line from a file.
* PlayerMute - Mutes selected players and provides an in-game player list/editor.

### Movement

* BunnyHop - Jumps automatically to maintain movement momentum.
* AutoSprint - Keeps the player sprinting without holding the sprint key.
* AutoSwim - Automatically triggers swimming movement when appropriate.
* AutoWalk - Moves forward continuously without holding the movement key.
* Dolphin - Provides dolphin-like bobbing movement in water.
* EntityControl - Adds configurable control over rideable entities.
* InvWalk - Allows movement while inventories and other screens are open.
* PearlDrop - Drops ender pearls into suitable stasis-chamber locations.
* SafeWalk - Prevents accidentally walking off block edges.
* Sneak - Keeps the player sneaking automatically.

### Combat

* AntiProjectile - Deflects incoming fireballs and shulker bullets with prediction, range, cooldown, and inventory controls.
* AttributeSwap - Swaps configured equipment or attributes for selected mechanics, with target-slot restrictions.
* AutoLeave - Leaves the server when configured health or danger conditions are reached.
* AutoRespawn - Automatically respawns after death.
* AutoTotem - Moves Totems of Undying to the off-hand and can display totem-pop counts.
* PearlIntercept - Throws a pearl to match another player’s pearl location.
* ShieldSwing - Keeps a shield raised while allowing configured attacks.
* WindChargeKey - Provides key-driven wind-charge movement controls.

### Render

* BlockOverlay - Customizes block-selection and mining-progress overlays with independent colors, fill, opacity, pulse, glow, rainbow, and through-wall settings.
* Breadcrumbs - Draws a trail showing where the player has travelled.
* DamageESP - Shows floating damage numbers with configurable text, fade, opacity, and chat-summary options.
* DurabilityHUD - Displays armor and held-item durability, including optional enchantment colors.
* ElytraInfo - Shows flight-related Elytra information and durability.
* Freecam - Moves the camera independently of the player.
* Fullbright - Increases client-side brightness for dark areas.
* HealthTags - Shows health values in player nametags.
* HideModMenu - Hides selected mods from the Mod Menu.
* HideWurst - Hides client rendering and related on-screen indicators.
* MobOwners - Shows ownership information for tamed and ownable entities.
* NameTags - Improves nametag visibility and readability.
* NewChunks - Highlights newly generated chunks.
* NewerNewChunks - Detects newer chunks with improved classification and evidence handling.
* NoBackground - Removes dark GUI and inventory backgrounds.
* NoFireOverlay - Removes the fire overlay while burning.
* NoShieldOverlay - Moves the shield overlay to improve visibility.
* NoVignette - Removes the dark screen-edge vignette.
* NoWeather - Changes or disables client-side weather and time visuals.
* Mapa - Displays a rendered world map with supported ESP information.
* MeasurementESP - Draws a precise measurement box along the look direction.
* PotESP - Finds suspicious decorated pots and displays their contents with optional alerts.
* ProjectileESP - Highlights projectiles with owner, type, filtering, and color options.
* RoofESP - Highlights usable roof and bedrock-area spaces.
* SkyBuildESP - Finds high-altitude builds in supported dimensions.
* StasisDetector - Finds likely ender-pearl stasis chambers and renders them with optional alerts.
* Viewmodel - Adjusts first-person item position and rendering.
* Waypoints - Creates and displays world markers, death points, and shared ping locations.

### Intelligence

* BedrockStash - Finds usable spaces within bedrock for hiding storage.
* Breadcrumbs - Tracks and renders the player’s travel path.
* LivestreamDetector - Detects livestreamers in the player list.
* NewChunks - Highlights newly generated chunks around the player.
* NewerNewChunks - Provides an alternative chunk-generation detector.
* OppStats - Tracks observed opponent equipment changes and history.
* StaffMonitor - Detects staff-related gamemode changes, missing tab-list players, and configured staff names.

### Tools

* AntiCheatDetect - Identifies common anti-cheat behavior and setback events.
* CheatDetector - Reports suspicious nearby player movement and combat.
* CommandScanner - Enumerates server commands.
* EntityCount - Displays per-chunk entity-count labels and thresholds.
* GameStats - Shows FPS, TPS, ping, play time, packet rate, distances, kills, XP, and session statistics.
* HideModMenu - Hides selected client entries from the Mod Menu.
* HideWurst - Removes selected client indicators from the screen.
* PacketRate - Displays packet rate and can queue or drop packets above a configured limit.
* SeedMapperHelper - Provides the NiceWurst interface for the SeedMapper fork.
* UI-Utils - Adds small interface and inventory workflow utilities.

### Other

* AntiAFK - Simulates configurable activity to avoid AFK detection.
* Antisocial - Disconnects when configured players enter range.
* AutoFish - Automates fishing and can switch to better rods.
* AutoLibrarian - Automates librarian-villager training for selected enchanted books.
* AutoReconnect - Reconnects after a disconnect.
* AutoTrader - Automates repetitive villager trading interactions.
* ClickGUI - Provides the graphical hack and settings interface.
* DamageDetect - Reports damage source and location in chat.
* DamageDetect - Reports what damaged the player and where it happened.
* FeedAura - Feeds nearby animals when applicable.
* GlobalToggle - Provides global settings for ESP/tracer range and source filters.
* Navigator - Provides searchable feature navigation and keybind management.
* Panic - Disables enabled hacks as an emergency action.
* PortalGUI - Allows GUI interaction while inside portals.
* SafeTP - Uses a temporary Blink period while issuing a teleport command.
* ShearAura - Shears configured entities and removes configurable equipment such as wolf armor, carpets, harnesses, saddles, and armor.
* TooManyHax - Restricts risky feature combinations and unwanted features.
* WebhookAlert - Sends configurable Discord webhook alerts for player and world detections.
* RemoteEChest - Opens the linked Ender Chest remotely and supports configurable keybinds.

### Items

* AntiBreak - Prevents damageable tools from being used below a configurable durability threshold.
* AntiDrop - Prevents accidental drops of selected items and blocks queued drop-key presses.
* AutoDisenchant - Feeds items into a grindstone to remove enchantments.
* AutoDrop - Discards unwanted inventory items, including an optional packet-only mode.
* AutoEat - Eats automatically at configured hunger or health thresholds, with controls for flying, targets, and walls.
* AutoLoot - Upgrades armor and equipment from valuable drops and optionally from opened chests and shulker boxes.
* AutoSteal - Takes matching items from opened chests and shulker boxes.
* ChestSearch - Searches opened containers for matching items and highlights useful containers.
* EnchantmentHandler - Displays enchantment breakdowns in container screens, tooltips, and Chest Search results.
* InventorySorter - Sorts and stacks items in containers or the player inventory.
* ItemHandler - Provides a HUD and GUI for inspecting nearby dropped items and entity/item ownership data.
* JoinDrop - Drops selected item types shortly after joining a server.
* LootSearch - Exports and searches structure loot-table information through the SeedMapper interface.
* QuickShulker - Places, fills, and breaks shulkers to move inventory quickly.
* RemoteEChest - Opens an Ender Chest remotely without a physical chest.
* SignFramePT - Forwards interactions through item frames or signs to the block behind them.
* SusNoMore - Reveals suspicious sand and gravel loot and can automatically break it.
* UseItemSpam - Repeatedly uses selected item types with configurable delays and modes.
* XCarry - Keeps the extra crafting-grid slots usable and can empty them safely.

## Runtime Notes
It uses the NiceWurst mod ID, branding, metadata, and separate configuration directory. It cannot and will not run any Wurst7-CevAPI modules as they are not visible or included post-build.
